description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Orleans silo builders to use an in-memory reminder service, primarily for development and testing scenarios. It defines a static class with methods to set up in-memory reminder storage by registering relevant services into dependency injection containers.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderMemoryExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection to configure in-memory reminder storage.

methods.name: UseInMemoryReminderService
methods.description: Configures reminder storage using an in-memory, non-persistent store, for development and testing scenarios. Extends both ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection.
